# Comfy PixVerse V6 Max- Image to Video

Animate a still image with PixVerse V6 Max, keeping the aspect ratio of the input image and generating up to 15 seconds at up to 1080p with an optional native audio track. Ideal for bringing product shots, character art and keyframes to life for social and advertising use. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_pixverse_v6_max_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
